title: Brood Loom — widow-inspired Warden boss kitbash visual spike
status: Visual prototype; no combat integration or collision/rig contract implied
coordinate_system: GLB uses metres, Y up, +Z forward; build script uses Blender conversion explicitly

source_provenance.license_claim: No additional public licence asserted; repository donor provenance only
No additional public licence asserted; repository donor provenance only
No additional public licence asserted; repository donor provenance only

design: Eight splayed legs, high split abdomen, six suspended pale ceramic brood capsules, small six-eyed head. Every exported mesh comes from donor geometry, with partial shell extraction on two meshes.

animations.name: idle
animations.description: Abdomen breathing, head scanning and subtle capsule sway; fixed leg stance.

animations.name: brood_open
animations.description: Split upper carapace opens; suspended capsules spread slightly and return.

authored_geometry: No creature primitives generated. Render floor and light/camera objects are excluded from GLB.
limitations: Rigid object articulation, no skeleton or skinning.
Visual clips only; no combat behavior, hitboxes, collision mesh, LOD, or attachment contract.
No texture baking; donor geometry receives new flat PBR materials.
Cut carapace borders are open single surfaces over a closed inner sac.
